description: Searches hotels and other places to stay by city or country and check-in/check-out dates, with optional filters for brand, room type, maximum nightly rate, star rating and amenities. Results come from LiteAPI, WebBeds and hotels contracted directly with Autonomad, and include nightly and total rates, room options, the cancellation policy, a photo and whether each result can be booked. Every star level is included, ranked best first (guest score or star rating, then price); a hotel whose star rating is unknown has `stars` null. If the person wants only higher-rated hotels, pass min_star_rating (hotels with an unknown rating are then left out and counted in meta.unrated_excluded); if they want the cheapest first, pass flexible: true. Searching does not reserve anything or charge anyone. If the traveller gave no length, assume about 7 nights abroad (6 for Mexico, 4 for Canada from the US), 3 at home, and tell them it's an assumption.

amenities.description: Required amenities (wifi, gym, pool, spa, restaurant, etc.)

brand.description: Hotel brand name to filter by

destination_iata.description: IATA code of the airport the traveller flies into (e.g. 'LAS'). Pass it whenever a flight is known: it decides which same-named city is meant (Las Vegas NV vs NM).

flexible.description: true: order results cheapest first instead of best first.

latitude.description: Latitude of the destination, when known.

longitude.description: Longitude of the destination, when known.

min_star_rating.description: Minimum star rating (1-5). Hotels whose rating is unknown are left out and counted in meta.unrated_excluded.

place.description: The exact place of this trip stop: the `place` an earlier search for the trip returned, or the candidate the person picked when a search asked which place they meant. Searches given the same place cover the same place.

airports.description: IATA codes of the airports serving the place.

arrival_airports.description: The airports to fly this place by, best first, as a search returned them. Pass them back unchanged.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (territories use their own, e.g. PR).

extent_km.description: The size of a region or island, as a search returned it.

gateway_airport.description: The one airport a wide search flies this place by, as a search returned it.

kind.description: What the place is, as a search returned it. Pass it back unchanged: a town, region or island has its hotels searched around it.

label.description: How to name the place to the person, e.g. 'Birmingham, GB'.

radius_km.description: The hotel search radius for this place, as a search returned it.

region.description: State / region of the city (e.g. 'NV', 'Nevada', 'Maine'), when known.

name: search_hotels
